ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the circuit below, it represents a partial circuit for motor self-locking continuous control and jog control. Pressing which of the following buttons can achieve the specified control?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: on the right side of the figure there is a contactor coil labeled KM; on the left side a stop button SB1 is connected in series; on the middle main branch there is a button SB2; in the lower parallel branch there is an auxiliary contact labeled KM, forming a self-locking holding branch; on the right side, near before the KM coil, there is also the linked contact group of SB3, and a dashed line is used to indicate its mechanical linkage relationship. Then reason: when SB2 is pressed, the current can make the KM coil energized, and afterward the lower KM auxiliary contact closes, forming a holding path, so SB2 corresponds to continuous/self-locking start. When SB3 is pressed, it provides an instantaneous path that makes the KM coil energized, while its linked contact makes the KM self-locking branch unable to maintain closed holding, so after release KM loses power, matching the characteristic of jog control. Therefore, to implement jog control, SB3 should be pressed.

raw_record.question_text: In the shown motor self-locking continuous control and jog-control circuit, which button should be pressed to achieve jog control?

method.method_draft: First describe the image structure: identify the KM coil at the right, the KM auxiliary contact on the lower branch, and the pushbuttons SB1, SB2, and SB3. Trace what happens when SB2 is pressed: current can energize KM and then the lower KM auxiliary contact provides a holding path, so SB2 corresponds to continuous/self-locking start. Then trace the SB3 contact group: pressing SB3 provides the momentary path to the KM coil while its linked contact prevents the KM self-lock branch from maintaining the circuit. Therefore the button used for jog control is SB3.

method.method_draft: First describe the visual labels and symbols: locate SB3 and note its dashed mechanical linkage to the associated contact, showing it is a combined pushbutton designed to change two contacts simultaneously. Recall that in self-locking plus jog circuits, the jog button is the compound button that closes the coil path but opens or bypasses the holding path, unlike the ordinary start button SB2. Match this conventional jog-button symbol to the label in the image, giving SB3 as the button to press for jog control.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是电动机自锁连续控制与点动控制电路，能看到按钮标号 SB1、SB2、SB3，以及接触器线圈 KM 和 KM 辅助触点。SB2 位于主控制回路中，像普通启动按钮；SB3 标在右侧，其旁边有一条竖向虚线，把上、下相关触点机械联动起来，表示它是一个复合按钮，按下时可同时改变两个触点状态。
